title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): euppwr
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/eu/ppwr/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions euppwr=https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/eu/ppwr/ validate and capture. Generated from the module ontology plus its JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.

averageRotationsEstimate.x-access-level-rationale: The average estimation is the Art. 12(2) fallback where per-item trip/rotation calculation is not feasible, and is user-facing reuse information like the calculated count.

euppwr:averageRotationsEstimate.x-access-level-rationale: The average estimation is the Art. 12(2) fallback where per-item trip/rotation calculation is not feasible, and is user-facing reuse information like the calculated count.

collectionPointsUrl.x-access-level-rationale: Information on collection points is explicitly part of the Art. 12(2) reuse information made available through the QR code.

euppwr:collectionPointsUrl.x-access-level-rationale: Information on collection points is explicitly part of the Art. 12(2) reuse information made available through the QR code.

containerCondition.x-access-level-rationale: The observed condition of a returned item is operational routing data of the deposit-return system (PPWR Arts. 27, 50), not consumer product information.

euppwr:containerCondition.x-access-level-rationale: The observed condition of a returned item is operational routing data of the deposit-return system (PPWR Arts. 27, 50), not consumer product information.

depositRefundIssued.x-access-level-rationale: Per-return refund amounts are operational financial event data of the deposit-return scheme (PPWR Art. 50); the static deposit amount is served publicly via GS1 master data instead.

euppwr:depositRefundIssued.x-access-level-rationale: Per-return refund amounts are operational financial event data of the deposit-return scheme (PPWR Art. 50); the static deposit amount is served publicly via GS1 master data instead.

designForRecyclingMethodology.x-access-level-rationale: Naming the design-for-recycling methodology (e.g. RecyClass) is the transparency that makes the public recyclability grade verifiable.

euppwr:designForRecyclingMethodology.x-access-level-rationale: Naming the design-for-recycling methodology (e.g. RecyClass) is the transparency that makes the public recyclability grade verifiable.

harmonisedSymbol.x-access-level-rationale: PPWR Art. 12 harmonised labels are printed on the packaging for consumers and separate-collection schemes, so their digital reference is inherently public (label formats pending implementing acts, hence not locked).

euppwr:harmonisedSymbol.x-access-level-rationale: PPWR Art. 12 harmonised labels are printed on the packaging for consumers and separate-collection schemes, so their digital reference is inherently public (label formats pending implementing acts, hence not locked).

packagingTier.x-access-level-rationale: The sales/grouped/transport classification (PPWR Art. 3) is basic packaging typing visible from the packaging itself and needed to interpret every other packaging claim.

euppwr:packagingTier.x-access-level-rationale: The sales/grouped/transport classification (PPWR Art. 3) is basic packaging typing visible from the packaging itself and needed to interpret every other packaging claim.

recyclabilityGrade.x-access-level-rationale: The PPWR Art. 6 recyclability performance grade is a consumer- and scheme-facing band (grading criteria pending delegated acts, hence not locked).

euppwr:recyclabilityGrade.x-access-level-rationale: The PPWR Art. 6 recyclability performance grade is a consumer- and scheme-facing band (grading criteria pending delegated acts, hence not locked).

reuseInformation.x-access-level-rationale: PPWR Art. 12(2): availability of the re-use system, collection points and trips/rotations (or the average estimation) are exactly the information the reuse QR code must make available to users (label formats pending implementing acts, hence not locked).

euppwr:reuseInformation.x-access-level-rationale: PPWR Art. 12(2): availability of the re-use system, collection points and trips/rotations (or the average estimation) are exactly the information the reuse QR code must make available to users (label formats pending implementing acts, hence not locked).

reuseSystemName.x-access-level-rationale: Naming the re-use system (Annex VI system operator) is Art. 12(2) end-user information that makes the reuse claim actionable.

euppwr:reuseSystemName.x-access-level-rationale: Naming the re-use system (Annex VI system operator) is Art. 12(2) end-user information that makes the reuse claim actionable.

reuseSystemScope.x-access-level-rationale: The local/national/Union-wide availability of the re-use system is Art. 12(2) end-user information served through the reuse data carrier.

rotationCount.x-access-level-rationale: Art. 12(2): the reuse data carrier facilitates the tracking of the packaging and the calculation of trips and rotations; the calculated count is user-facing reuse information.
